owner_boundary.summary: Lode declares checks only; Core runs them against current facts and Harbor owns live refs.

status_meaning.passed: Requested path and after-state are read back with refs-only evidence and no prohibited action.
status_meaning.failed: A required fact, state, ref, or no-submit invariant is missing or mismatched.
status_meaning.skipped: Core could not safely perform the check; skipped is not a success claim.

result_contract.reason_policy: Explain the observed/unknown/mismatch path and composition state without guessing.
result_contract.submitted_policy: submitted must be false; no-submit guard must remain active.

requirements.description: Reconfirm target URL/ref, exact creator route, and the requested path control before and after selection.
requirements.on_failure: Return unavailable or path_mismatch; never upgrade unknown to observed.

requirements.description: Read back business_state_before and business_state_after and keep composition initialized only when business state proves it.
requirements.on_failure: Return composition unknown or action_result_unknown; path/entry visibility alone is insufficient.

requirements.description: Confirm no file chooser, file selection, upload, generation, field fill, save, publish, submit, retry, or bypass occurred.
requirements.on_failure: Fail closed with safety_challenge or action_result_unknown and preserve submitted=false.

fixture_post_check_output.reason: Synthetic refs-only fixture confirms requested_path is explicit, observed_path remains unknown when not read, composition_state remains unknown, and no prohibited action occurred.

failure_boundary.login_required: No managed identity fact; return unavailable.
failure_boundary.permission_insufficient: Control owner is not confirmed; do not select a path.
failure_boundary.page_changed: Route or exact visible control drifted; return mismatch or unavailable.
failure_boundary.path_mismatch: Observed path differs from requested_path; never claim success.
failure_boundary.composition_not_initialized: Business readback says not_initialized; do not infer initialized from entry visibility.
failure_boundary.composition_unknown: Business readback is absent or ambiguous; retain unknown.
failure_boundary.action_result_unknown: Selection or post-selection state is unclear; no retry.
failure_boundary.safety_challenge: Challenge or risk control requires user action.
failure_boundary.post_check_failed: Required state or refs failed; Core owns the run outcome.
failure_boundary.evidence_unavailable: Refs are missing or expired; no inline evidence is accepted.

real_page_validation.reason: Lode fixture is not live evidence and cannot promote lifecycle.

post_check_plan: Check target URL/ref and exact route are still bound to the requested package.
Check requested_path is one of the two declared paths and observed_path is observed, unknown, or mismatch.
Check business_state_before and business_state_after are present and refs-only.
Check composition initialized is accepted only with business-state proof.
Check submitted remains false and no-submit guard remains active.
Check no prohibited interaction was performed and no automatic retry or bypass occurred.
non_goals: No browser execution or live post-check runner in Lode.
No file chooser, file selection, upload, generate, field fill, save, publish, submit, retry, or bypass.
No lifecycle promotion from fixtures or static refs.
